gallery.blurb: Conway's Game of Life on a large grid with fading trails where cells have died, seeded with oscillators and glider guns; anyone can drop a glider in their own colour, and the colony is reseeded if it dies out.
gallery.prompt: Conway's Game of Life on a large grid with fading trails where cells have died, seeded with oscillators and glider guns; anyone can drop a glider in their own colour, and the colony is reseeded if it dies out. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
